target_customer: Online resellers on Poshmark, Mercari, Depop and eBay
problem: Resellers spend hours listing, delisting and relisting the same items across marketplaces.
business_model: Subscription SaaS (blog cites $1 per week for new sellers and $13 per week standard)

founders.name: Albert Chuang
founders.background_notes: Per YC page bio, which also says OneShop reached $4.5M per year under him; he is now at Final per YC page.

founders.name: Aaron Evans
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; the launch post is co-written with Aaron.

technical_complexity.rationale: Automating listings on marketplaces without official APIs, with fragile browser and app automation.

defensibility.rationale: Several competitors offered the same features and marketplaces control access.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Marketplaces did not buy it in the sources found; Poshmark was acquired by Naver (Business of Fashion result, date not captured).

market_need_then: Resale marketplaces were growing and resellers listed manually on many sites; the company reported $4.5M annual revenue run rate per the founder bio.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name, appears in crosslisting comparison posts alongside rivals; no community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: OneShop built a marketplace crosslisting tool and grew to a reported 4.5 million dollars annual revenue, then listed as inactive by YC while its site still offers a free trial. The cause or date of any wind down is not public, and the founder moved on to other roles, so no failure factor is asserted.
notes: YC says inactive but oneshop.com is live with footer 2024. The June 2021 convertible note rests on CB Insights and the September 2021 seed (General Catalyst, Garry Tan, amount unknown) rests on one aggregator, Bounce Watch. CB Insights also lists a Chief Product Officer, Suzanne Wouk, not on the YC page, so not listed as co-founder. Competitors are named only in the company's trademark notice, with no traction data.
